Detailed Description

plugin that creates a file-info "tooltip"

this plugin creates tooltips that are centered around the item the tooltip is for.

some tunables exist as defines and should be turned into properties at some point. ###

create a tooltip.

no assumptions about the nature of the tooltip are made; for all the main application knows, the plugin might read the info to the user aloud.

Returns:
a handle to pass to tt_dst() when destroy the tooltip.
Parameters:
data - the icon-list the tooltip is related to
x - x-position of the icon the info is for
y - y-position of the icon the info is for
fi - the file we're displaying info for
